args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Pellucid Harbor Logistics
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Since then, filtering "PHL" returns both Pellow Home Living (Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments) and Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows). The two are separate businesses.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" (per Moss's coverage digest), so the old name is still showing in search results.
- Sofia said she would relabel the saved retail view with the full name and check the next export. Kwame is fixing the terminal view.

Let me know if you need anything else for the deal desk record.

Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:

- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name keeps showing up in search.
- Open items: Sofia is relabelling the saved retail view with the full name and checking the next export. Kwame is fixing the terminal view.

Sofia and Bettina
